1: ## 1. Tooling configuration and dependencies
2: 
3: - [ ] 1.1 Add devDependencies to `package.json`: `eslint`, `@eslint/js`, `globals`, `prettier`, `eslint-config-prettier`, `typescript`
4: - [ ] 1.2 Add npm scripts to `package.json`: `lint`, `format`, `format:check`, `typecheck`, `check` (aggregate)
5: - [ ] 1.3 Create `eslint.config.js` (flat config) with `@eslint/js` recommended + correctness rules + `eslint-config-prettier` to disable style conflicts
6: - [ ] 1.4 Create `.prettierrc` with project formatting choices (verify by running on a sample file)
7: - [ ] 1.5 Create `.prettierignore` excluding `node_modules`, `package-lock.json`, `.worktrees`, generated artifacts
8: - [ ] 1.6 Create `tsconfig.json` configured for type checking only: `noEmit: true`, `allowJs: true`, `checkJs: true`, target ES2022, strict where reasonable, include `js/**/*.js`
9: - [ ] 1.7 Verify `npm run lint` runs without errors against current code (fix any real issues surfaced)
10: - [ ] 1.8 Verify `npm run typecheck` runs without errors with no `// @ts-check` directives present yet (sanity check)
11: 
12: ## 2. Continuous integration
13: 
14: - [ ] 2.1 Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` triggered on `push` and `pull_request` against `main`
15: - [ ] 2.2 Workflow steps: checkout → setup Node 20 LTS → `npm ci` → `npm run check`
16: - [ ] 2.3 Push the branch and open a PR to confirm CI runs and reports status
17: 
18: ## 3. Shared types module
19: 
20: - [ ] 3.1 Create `js/modules/types.js` containing only JSDoc `@typedef` blocks (no runtime exports)
21: - [ ] 3.2 Define typedefs: `AuthSession`, `Account`, `Checkpoint`, `SplitAnalysis`, `FollowedTag`, `ContinuationToot`, `PendingAuth`, `InstanceLimits`, `PublishProgress`, `PublishResult`
22: - [ ] 3.3 Cross-reference each typedef field against existing usage to confirm shapes match runtime reality
23: 
24: ## 4. Apply `// @ts-check` to module-boundary files
25: 
26: - [ ] 4.1 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/constants.js` and resolve any errors
27: - [ ] 4.2 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/storage.js`, annotate function signatures with JSDoc referencing `types.js`, resolve errors
28: - [ ] 4.3 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/api.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
29: - [ ] 4.4 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/auth.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
30: - [ ] 4.5 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/splitter.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
31: - [ ] 4.6 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/publisher.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
32: - [ ] 4.7 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/continuation.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
33: - [ ] 4.8 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/instances.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
34: - [ ] 4.9 Add `// @ts-check` to `js/modules/hashtags.js`, annotate function signatures, resolve errors
35: - [ ] 4.10 Confirm `js/main.js` and `js/modules/ui.js` do NOT have `// @ts-check`
36: 
37: ## 5. Final formatting pass and verification
38: 
39: - [ ] 5.1 Run `npm run format` once to apply Prettier across the tree (separate commit isolating formatting churn)
40: - [ ] 5.2 Run `npm run check` end-to-end and confirm clean exit
41: - [ ] 5.3 Open the app in a browser and verify it still loads and signs in correctly (sanity check that no runtime path was disturbed)
42: - [ ] 5.4 Confirm CI passes on the PR
